description: This file defines the BlogController class for the Goteo project. It handles displaying lists of blog posts, individual blog post pages, and redirects, utilizing models such as Post and Tag, and interacts with repositories and view rendering.

classes.name: BlogController
classes.description: Controller class managing blog-related pages, including listing posts, displaying individual posts, and handling related redirects.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles display of blog post list, with support for filtering by section and tag, and pagination.

methods.name: postAction
methods.description: Handles display of a single blog post identified by slug, with checks for publication status, related posts, and redirects.
